about: ENDPOINTS_40.md (section 28): endpoint sets and failover. Made by tools/endpoints40.py --write; do not edit by hand.
answers_are: {answer: none | stalled} when none came; else {status, body: json | bytes | html | empty | invalid, error, reason, core, retry_after?}: json the route's own answer, bytes a model file 16.1 holds to be the file, invalid a JSON or bytes answer that fails the route's check; core for the lease route as grace.json; routes: config, register, token, challenge, attest, model-key, manifest, file, engine

config_lists.name: an added host of the allow-list is used (a later provider, no SDK update)
a host of another domain is dropped
a lookalike is dropped: evilquranlab.ai and quranlab.ai.example.net
an entry with a scheme, a port or a path is dropped
more than 8 entries: refused whole, the built-in list
a config that has expired: the built-in lists, its added hosts never used
a models host named for api is kept (the allow-list, not the role, decides)
an empty list: the built-in list
not an array: the built-in list
web_frame is never taken from a config
endpoints that is not an object

bases.name: an allowed host that is not one of the role: asked first
a name that only contains ours

requests_are: per step: the time in seconds, each host's answer, the hosts asked in order, the class the request ended on (taken, refused, slow_down, unreachable), the host that ended it, fallback (more than one host asked), probe (the probe back), and P after it; a step {list} is a config list that changes

requests.name: the first host refuses the connection: the standby answers, and the next request goes to it first
the first host answers 503: the standby answers, and the next request goes to it first
the first host stalls: the standby answers, and the next request goes to it first
the first host answers a redirect: the standby answers, and the next request goes to it first
the first host answers a firewall page (a 403 that is not the API's): the standby answers, and the next request goes to it first
the first host answers 200 with a captive portal's page: the standby answers, and the next request goes to it first
the first host answers a config that does not verify: the standby answers, and the next request goes to it first
probe back at 30 minutes: the first host answers again and is P again
probe back while the first host is still down: the standby for 30 more minutes
a refusal on the standby is the answer: the third host is never asked
a refusal on the first host: no other host is asked
a 429 on the first host: no other host is asked, P stays
a 429 on the standby after the first host failed: the third is not asked
every host unreachable: P and its time stay
the reserved third host answers when the first two do not
P on the standby: a request that finds it down goes to the first host, then the third
a 304 to a config with If-None-Match on the standby is taken
a lease the Core refuses is unreachable: the next host is asked
a config list changes: the standby first, then one that disables it
a host the config adds is asked; when that config expires the built-in list is back
models: the first CDN down, the manifest and the files from the standby CDN
models: a 429 model_limit is never taken to another CDN
the fourth host answers when the first three do not
web_frame (Node: the engine files): the hosts in order

attempts.name: the first host down, the standby gives the lease
the first host answers the challenge, then goes down: the lease from the standby with that challenge
a refusal from the standby is the attempt's refusal: the third host is never asked
a signed stop from the standby is a stop
unreachable only when every host was: grace may open
the lease request unreachable on every host after a challenge from the first
a 429 on the first host ends the attempt there: unreachable for the grace, no other host asked
401 invalid_token on the standby: the token renewed (through the api order), the repeat gives a lease
install_cert_invalid on the standby: attest again there, then the lease
a lease the Core refuses on the first host: the same request, its challenge unchanged, to the standby, which gives a lease

downloads_are: one file of size bytes, nothing stored at the start, P before it; answers: what each attempt got, a bytes answer {status 200 | 206, deliver n, end complete | stall | reset} or any answer; requests: the host, the Range, the If-Range sent (null for none) and the pause before it

downloads.name: the first CDN fails mid-file: the standby resumes with Range and no If-Range
the first CDN never answers: the whole file from the standby
the standby stalls too: the third and fourth hosts, then back to the first with its own validator
P on the standby: the file starts there; its validator goes back to it only
a 503 on the first CDN: the standby
a 206 of another total is a failed attempt: the next host
a refusal on the standby is asked once and on no other host
a 429 on the first CDN: no other host, asked once
every host fails: download_failed after the five resumes
a whole file in answer to a range on another host takes the place when complete
a redirect on the first CDN: the standby, after the first pause
a 403 that is not the API's (a firewall page) mid-file: the third host resumes
503 network_blocked on the first CDN: the standby

downloads_if_range: 28.4: if_range is what an SDK may send, and only to the host whose ETag it is; an SDK may send no If-Range at all (web keeps a range map and sends none), so a replay takes null or the value where a value is given, and only null where null is given
first_manifest_are: 28.4: the manifest of a build: before the install holds a lease for it, from the folder qlab-api names in every lease answer (MODEL_BASE's path /models, the config's model, the build, the config's folder); with a lease held, from that lease's folder; asked through the models order, a base host that is not one of the role's first

first_manifest.name: no lease yet: the folder qlab-api names, through the models order
a lease held whose base is the standby's: that folder, the order unchanged
a lease held whose base is another allowed host: that host first
